name: Drogo Aerospace

at_a_glance.Products (as stated): JK 250e surveillance/recon UAV; Delta Wing Kamikaze UAV / loitering-munition platform (development)
at_a_glance.Design origin: Indian — Company describes platforms as indigenous (L3)
at_a_glance.Assembly / integration: India — Delivery to Army implies Indian integration — facility and content unverified (L2)
at_a_glance.Technology origin: UNKNOWN — JK 250e described as Make in India; propulsion, battery, avionics and datalink sourcing undisclosed.

what_it_is.prose:
Hyderabad defence UAV maker (formerly Drogo Drones). Reported to have delivered a first batch of 41 JK 250e drones to the Indian Army (Southern Command) in June 2026 under a ₹72 crore contract; MoU with Munitions India (Sep 2026) on UAVs and loitering munitions.

Value-chain position in the Atlas: Supplies to → Indian Army (L2); Partners / JV with → Munitions India Limited (L2); Develops → Loitering munitions (L3).

Evidence discipline: this record separates company claims from independent evidence. Classifications above carry their evidence level; the technology-origin class is 'UNKNOWN'. Exhibiting at Drone Expo 2026 establishes market presence only — not indigenous technology, Indian manufacturing, procurement or deployment.

deployments_procurement.summary: Reported delivery of 41 JK 250e to Indian Army Southern Command (Nashik) under ₹72 crore contract, June 2026 (L2 — multiple outlets, no MoD primary). rows.quantity_or_note: MoU signed 4 Sep 2026, Pune. Collaboration framework only — no order, quantity or value.

faq.question: Is Drogo Aerospace's technology indigenous?

sources.title: Drogo Aerospace delivers first batch of 41 JK 250e drones to Army
sources.note: Evidence level 2. Independent media (search abstract, 2026-09-30): first batch of 41 JK 250e drones received by Army Southern Command officials at Nashik under a ₹72 crore contract; balance targeted by August 2026. Corroborated by Siasat. No MoD primary document located.

sources.title: Hyderabad defence firm supplies drones to Indian Army
sources.note: Evidence level 2. Independent media corroboration of the JK 250e first-batch delivery; company formerly Drogo Drones Pvt Ltd, headquartered in Madhapur, Hyderabad.

sources.title: Munitions India, Drogo Aerospace sign MoU for loitering munition, UAV systems
sources.note: Evidence level 2. Independent media (search abstract): MoU signed in Pune on 4 Sep 2026 between Munitions India Limited (DPSU) and Drogo Aerospace for design, development and integration of indigenous UAVs and loitering munitions. An MoU is not an order. Corroborated by Devdiscourse, GKToday, Newsable.
